title: Edgar Mitchell's Apollo 14 ESP experiment and Noetic society

tellings.quote: it's an experiment with the Swedish guy

plain: On the Apollo 14 mission in 1971, the astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have run a private experiment in ESP (extrasensory perception, meaning mind-to-mind communication) from space, and the work led him toward a society for studying consciousness, which the story calls a Noetic society. The Swedish UFO researcher and archivist Clas Svahn brings it up with Michels, describing it as "an experiment with the Swedish guy," meaning a Swedish man who was on the receiving end on Earth. It would mean one of the men who walked on the Moon took telepathy seriously enough to test it on the way.
